relics.name: 调好的手电
relics.description: 每场战斗开始时获得 3 点格挡。
relics.descriptionEn: Gain 3 block at the start of each battle.

relics.name: 床单绳
relics.description: 吓人机关造成的伤害降低 3 点。
relics.descriptionEn: Scary trap damage is reduced by 3.

relics.name: 幸运纽扣
relics.descriptionEn: Battle reward buttons are increased by 20%.

relics.name: 玻璃弹珠镜
relics.description: 卡牌奖励多出现 1 张选择。进入房间棋盘时预览 1 个隐藏格。
relics.descriptionEn: Card rewards offer 1 additional card. Preview 1 hidden tile when entering room boards.

relics.name: 旧姓名牌
relics.description: 每场战斗胜利后额外降低 1 点声响。
relics.descriptionEn: After each battle victory, reduce noise by 1 additional point.

relics.name: 玩具骷髅罗盘
relics.description: 每场战斗开始时额外抽 1 张牌。
relics.descriptionEn: Draw 1 extra card at the start of each battle.

relics.name: 余光电池
relics.description: 每场战斗第一回合获得 1 点额外能量。
relics.descriptionEn: Gain 1 extra energy on the first turn of each battle.

relics.name: 纸风车
relics.description: 灵感触发时额外获得 2 点格挡。

relics.name: 粉笔刻度尺
relics.description: 灵感触发时额外使所有敌人破势 +2。
relics.descriptionEn: Inspiration adds 2 additional stagger to all enemies.

relics.name: 午夜口袋
relics.description: 手电电量上限提高 15，战斗后恢复 4 点手电电量。
relics.descriptionEn: Max flashlight battery +15. Restore 4 battery after battles.

relics.name: 黑焦夜灯
relics.description: 每场战斗开始时额外抽 1 张牌并获得 1 点能量。
relics.descriptionEn: At battle start, draw 1 extra card and gain 1 energy.
